name: PO•PO•TAN
source:
The player assumes the role of Chris, the protagonist of Popotan. The main characters include three sisters and their maid who live in a western-style mansion. Ai is the eldest of the three and has the ability to communicate with plants. Mai is the middle sister; she is a tomboy and disapproves of Chris's slacker behavior. Mii is the youngest and the most energetic; she often cosplays as "Magical Girl Mii" and helps people out. Their maid Mare appears emotionless at first, but reveals hidden depth later in the story.

Popotan takes place in the distant future within the remnants of Tokyo, destroyed by a cataclysm and since altered by geological transformations. The disaster was caused by a giant dandelion structure resembling a spire that arose in the city atop a hill. The main location of the game is a European-style mansion, seen as completely out-of-place in the city. Much of the daytime is spent outside the mansion wandering around town meeting characters and triggering event sequences.

Popotan follows Chris's relationship with the girls as well as the mysteries surrounding the spire-like object that caused the destruction of Tokyo in the past. The story opens with Chris, hungry and penniless, arriving in the town where he is to begin working at a convenience store. He wanders around the town looking for a place to stay and comes across a mansion, where he then takes residence along with the sisters and their maid. As the story progresses, Chris begins developing a relationship with the girls. He also meets new friends, including Mai's classmate and Chris's childhood friend Konami, a local shrine maiden named Nono and a mysterious girl named Shizuku.

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Popotan]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
玩家扮演克里斯，Popotan的主人公。主要角色包括住在一座西式宅邸中的三姐妹和她们的女仆。爱是三姐妹中的老大，拥有与植物沟通的能力。舞是老二，是个假小子，不赞同克里斯懒散的行为。美是最小的也是最有活力的，经常cosplay成“魔法少女美”来帮助他人。她们的女仆玛蕾起初看起来面无表情，但在故事后期展现出了隐藏的深度。

Popotan的故事发生在遥远的未来，在东京的废墟之中——东京曾被一场灾难摧毁，后经地质变迁而改变。那场灾难是由山顶上一座类似尖塔的巨大蒲公英建筑引起的。游戏的主要场景是一座欧式宅邸，在城市中显得格格不入。白天大部分时间都在宅邸外度过，在城镇里闲逛，遇见各种角色并触发事件序列。

Popotan讲述了克里斯与女孩们的关系，以及围绕着过去导致东京毁灭的尖塔状物体的谜团。故事开始于又饿又穷的克里斯来到他即将开始在便利店工作的小镇。他在镇上四处寻找住处，来到了一座宅邸，随后与姐妹们和她们的女仆一起住了下来。随着故事的发展，克里斯开始与女孩们建立关系。他还结识了新朋友，包括舞的同学兼克里斯的青梅竹马小波、当地的巫女诺诺，以及一位神秘的女孩雫。
